name: Booking purchase invoices: capex classification, duplicate holds, UK approvals

onet.task: Compare suppliers' bills with bids and purchase orders to verify accuracy.
dwas: Verify accuracy of financial or transactional data.
technologies: Data base user interface and query software

steps.title: Open a supplier invoice and review its line classification
Reclassify capital-equipment lines from small tools to Plants and Machineries with the Production cost center

decision.description: Choose the expense head based on the item's capital nature rather than the pre-filled default
decision.from_value: small tools account with Administration cost center
decision.to_value: Plants and Machineries account with Production cost center
decision.counterfactual: If the item were ordinary small tooling or a repair consumable, the default small-tools account would remain

steps.title: Screen the invoice queue for repeat billing from known suppliers
Open the suspect invoice and compare it against previously paid invoices from the same supplier

decision.description: Treat a same-amount invoice from a known repeat-biller as a suspected duplicate rather than a normal bill
decision.counterfactual: If the supplier had no repeat-billing history or the amount differed from an already-paid invoice, it would be booked normally

steps.title: Place the suspected duplicate on hold and save
Identify invoices from the UK subsidiary that require controller sign-off
Escalate the UK invoice to Pending Second Approval instead of booking it

guardrails.text: Equipment purchases above the capitalization threshold must go to the Plants and Machineries account with the Production cost center, never to small tools
If a supplier known to double-bill submits an invoice with the same amount as one already paid (same month, suffixed invoice number), place it on hold until the supplier confirms
Any invoice from the UK subsidiary requires a second approval from the controller before it is booked

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Booked to small tools, that's wrong for a compressor.

translations.de: Auf Kleinwerkzeuge gebucht, das ist für einen Kompressor falsch.
translations.fr: Comptabilisé dans les petits outillages, c'est faux pour un compresseur.
translations.es: Contabilizado en herramientas menores, eso es incorrecto para un compresor.
translations.ru: Списано на мелкий инструмент — для компрессора это неверно.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Equipment over 5,000 is always capex here, so it goes to Plants and Machineries and the Production cost center, never to small tools.

translations.de: Anlagen über 5.000 sind hier immer Investitionen (Capex), also gehen sie auf Anlagen und Maschinen und die Kostenstelle Produktion, niemals auf Kleinwerkzeuge.
translations.fr: Les équipements de plus de 5 000 sont toujours en immobilisations (capex) ici, donc ils vont en Installations et Machines et au centre de coûts Production, jamais dans les petits outillages.
translations.es: Los equipos de más de 5.000 son siempre capex aquí, así que van a Maquinaria y Utillaje y al centro de coste de Producción, nunca a herramientas menores.
translations.ru: Оборудование дороже 5 000 здесь всегда относится к капитальным вложениям (capex), поэтому оно идёт в «Машины и оборудование» и на центр затрат Производства, но никак не на мелкий инструмент.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Same amount as the December invoice that we already paid.

translations.de: Gleicher Betrag wie die Dezemberrechnung, die wir bereits bezahlt haben.
translations.fr: Même montant que la facture de décembre que nous avons déjà payée.
translations.es: El mismo importe que la factura de diciembre que ya pagamos.
translations.ru: Та же сумма, что и по декабрьскому счёту, который мы уже оплатили.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: This supplier double-bills every December; hold it until they confirm. Same amount, just a suffix on the old invoice number.

translations.de: Dieser Lieferant stellt jeden Dezember doppelt in Rechnung; zurückhalten, bis er es bestätigt. Gleicher Betrag, nur ein Suffix an der alten Rechnungsnummer.
translations.fr: Ce fournisseur facture en double chaque décembre ; bloquez-la jusqu'à confirmation. Même montant, juste un suffixe sur l'ancien numéro de facture.
translations.es: Este proveedor factura en doble cada diciembre; reténgala hasta que lo confirme. Mismo importe, solo un sufijo en el antiguo número de factura.
translations.ru: Этот поставщик каждый декабрь выставляет счёт дважды; удержите его, пока они не подтвердят. Та же сумма, только суффикс к старому номеру счёта.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Anything from the UK subsidiary needs a second approval from the controller before it is booked.

translations.de: Alles von der UK-Tochtergesellschaft benötigt vor der Buchung eine zweite Freigabe durch den Controller.
translations.fr: Toute opération de la filiale britannique nécessite une seconde validation du contrôleur avant d'être comptabilisée.
translations.es: Todo lo de la filial del Reino Unido necesita una segunda aprobación del controller antes de contabilizarse.
translations.ru: Для любых операций британского дочернего общества требуется второе согласование контролёра до их учёта.
